rule: Spec: drive time to the nearest airport with YEAR-ROUND direct flights from Edinburgh (EDI) or Glasgow (GLA). 'year_round' counts in full; 'seasonal' counts much less in winter; 'none' or 'unknown' don't count until confirmed. The score page lets the user choose: year-round direct only, seasonal direct counted at reduced credit, or flights ignored (owner, 25 Oct 2026).
